messages.author: cd016d159ac3dc3c
messages.subject: ERROR task 1 failed - "'names' attribute [23] must be the same length as the vector [22]"
parts:
Hi, 

I have the latest version of Genomic SEM (version 0.0.5) but when I try to estimate the SNP effects using the userGWAS function I get the following error: 

[1] "Please note that an update was made to userGWAS on 11/21/19 so that it combines addSNPs and userGWAS." 
[1] "Starting GWAS Estimation" 
Error in .userGWAS_main(i, int, n_phenotypes, n, I_LD, V_LD, S_LD, std.lv, : task 51 failed - "'names' attribute [23] must be the same length as the vector [22]"

Here is some code and data to reproduce the error. 

Thanks! 

Camille

library(GenomicSEM)
library(data.table)

LDSCoutput <- readRDS("Sumstats_Meta.rds")
d1 <- fread("SNP_data_googlegroup.csv")

 model1 <- '
Internalizing =~ Neff_Meta_Dep + Neff_Meta_PTSD  + Neff_Meta_SH + Neff_Meta_ANX + Other.Substance.Hazard.Dependence_Neff + Neff_Meta_AUD
Thought_Disorder =~ Neff_Meta_BPD + Neff_Meta_SCZ
Compulsive_Disorder =~ Neff_Meta_OCD + Neff_Meta_Eat_Rev

Internalizing~~Compulsive_Disorder
Internalizing~~Thought_Disorder
Compulsive_Disorder~~Thought_Disorder

Internalizing~SNP
Thought_Disorder~SNP
Compulsive_Disorder~SNP
'
 
 extgwas <- userGWAS(covstruc = LDSCoutput,
                      SNPs = d1,
                      estimation = "DWLS",
                      model = model1,
                      sub=c("Internalizing~SNP", "Thought_Disorder~SNP", "Compulsive_Disorder~SNP"),
                      GC = "standard",smooth_check=TRUE)

extgwas

I know others have recently posted about seeing this error but I'm unable to reproduce it on either a Linux or MacOS environment. Attached is the .RData object from when I ran your code, including the resultant output.

Best,
